name: McDonald's
halal_source: McDonald's UK, public statement (X/Twitter, @McDonaldsUK): ran a halal trial, decided against it — "we have no plans to offer Halal food in the UK." No HMC/HFA/MCB certification anywhere in the UK estate. Verified via search 2026-07-28 (previously unsourced).

name: Burger King
halal_source: Burger King UK has not pursued chain-wide halal certification; a small number of individually-certified branches exist in Birmingham, Bradford, Manchester and parts of London. Sutton not confirmed as one of them (base rate strongly not_halal, but not individually checked). Verified via search 2026-07-28 (previously unsourced).

name: Popeyes UK
evidence_tier: brand-stated (supplier-level, chain-wide) — NOT independently HMC/HFA certified except the Stratford branch
halal_source: Popeyes UK states all UK chicken is halal-sourced from the supplier chain-wide (per customer-service/public statements). Not HMC/HFA third-party certified except Stratford. Shares fryers/prep with non-halal items (e.g. pork bacon) in most branches — cross-contamination risk, worth a "verify in store" flag for strict users. NOTE: the original "not halal" entry in this file was never actually sourced — it was written without a genuine search or fetch, in violation of the plan's own §3.3 rule. Corrected 2026-07-28 after user challenge.
